stations.title: Kwame
stations.say: Visit opens behind the big picture.

stations.title: Visit menu
stations.text: Opens, then slips under the picture.

captions: At the Wrenfield, Kwame clicks Visit and the menu opens behind the big picture.
The menu starts to open, then the picture covers all of it but its top edge.
You find what keeps the menu under the picture and fix it, and the seat guides too.
Now the Visit menu opens on top, with Find us, Access and The cafe in view.
Same header, same picture. The menu opens on top, on a phone and a wide screen.
